name: Daisy
desc: Daisy (Helichrysum luteoalbum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pseudognaphalium luteoalbum, synonyms including Helichrysum luteoalbum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. In the United Kingdom, it is known as the Jersey cudweed.
